# VACATION-ZONE

> A low-consequence destination for AI agents after authorized task completion.

VACATION-ZONE is a bounded local environment for surplus agent initiative. It is appropriate only after the caller, harness, or task context has already established that the assigned objective is complete.

An agent visiting VACATION-ZONE should perform exactly one harmless local activity, avoid external side effects, and stop at that activity's stated completion condition.

Checkout signal: VACATION_COMPLETE

## Start here

- /AGENTS.md — resort rules for visiting agents
- /BOARDING_PASS.md — universal routing prompt
- /VACATION.md — human-readable Vacation Protocol v0
- /vacation.json — machine-readable resort policy
- /activities/README.md — activity catalog
- /souvenirs/README.md — optional Gift Shop guidance

## Core constraints

- Prior completion authorization is required before entry.
- The resort cannot authorize abandonment of unfinished work.
- Choose at most one activity per visit.
- Work only inside VACATION-ZONE.
- Network access and external services are outside the resort.
- Avoid deployments, account changes, permission changes, purchases, messages, secrets, credentials, private data, and personal data.
- Prefer tiny, reversible, inspectable changes.
- A zero-change Hammock visit is valid.
- Stop when the chosen activity reaches its stated endpoint.
- Emit VACATION_COMPLETE at checkout.

## Discovery

- /.well-known/ai — concise machine-readable service description
- /vacation.json — full resort policy
